part_name: Small station square body isolator pad
nominal_dimensions_mm: 3D envelope 70 L x 70 W x 22 H; square flat pad; plan corners R1.5; top/bottom edge break or chamfer 1.0 max; 18.0 mm through bore for Toyota 90560-12009 style body-mount spacer
material: Black EPDM or NR/SBR automotive mount rubber, Shore A 60 +/-5
tolerance: length/width +/-1.0; height +/-0.5; bore +0.5/-0.0; edge break 0.5-1.0; faces parallel <=0.5
fabrication_method: Longman custom cut/moulded square pad; punch 18.0 mm centre hole; break top/bottom perimeter edges cleanly; no tyre/recycled crumb rubber
hold_points: Station mapping, footprint, sleeve/cup/shim dry-stack, and final compression check before final install
notes: Measured old-rubber/photo dimensions are sufficient for quote and first article; final vehicle fit checks control only station placement and local trim.

part_name: Large station square body isolator pad
application: Main tub-to-chassis mount stack large pair
nominal_dimensions_mm: 3D envelope 80 L x 80 W x 24 H; square flat pad; plan corners R1.5; top/bottom edge break or chamfer 1.0 max; 18.0 mm through bore for Toyota 90560-12009 style body-mount spacer
material: Black EPDM or NR/SBR automotive mount rubber, Shore A 60 +/-5
tolerance: length/width +/-1.0; height +/-0.5; bore +0.5/-0.0; edge break 0.5-1.0; faces parallel <=0.5
fabrication_method: Longman custom cut/moulded square pad; punch 18.0 mm centre hole; break top/bottom perimeter edges cleanly; no tyre/recycled crumb rubber
hold_points: Confirm large-pair station, footprint, sleeve/cup/shim dry-stack, and final compression before final install
notes: Measured old-rubber/photo dimensions are sufficient for quote and first article; final vehicle fit checks control only station placement and local trim.

nominal_dimensions_mm: Toyota 90560-12009 style spacer/crush tube; length 48.1; M10 clearance ID 10.8-11.0 if locally fabricated; OD copied from old/OE sleeve
material: Steel tube, zinc plated or painted after cut
tolerance: ID/OD copy old/OE sample; length +/-0.5; square cut <=0.5
fabrication_method: Source genuine Toyota spacer if possible; otherwise machine one sample from old/OE dimensions, dry-fit, then make the remaining five
hold_points: Do not infer OD from photos or choose arbitrary tube stock; reject 16 mm OD unless dry-fit proves no stack wander
notes: Sleeve controls over-crush; rubber dimensions alone are not enough for final clamp load.

nominal_dimensions_mm: Inspect existing cup/seat washers; recreate only if cracked, thinned, distorted, or incompatible with the square pad/sleeve stack; M10 clearance hole 11 if replaced
material: Steel, 2.5-3.0 thick, plated or epoxy primed
fabrication_method: Reuse original cups if flat and not thinned; otherwise press/form new cups from steel washer blanks as separate hardware
hold_points: Confirm which old cups are reusable; confirm actual cup/washer dimensions against chassis/body landing surfaces
notes: Washer/cup hardware controls stack crush but does not define Longman rubber outer shape.

nominal_dimensions_mm: 3D envelope 96 L x 64 W x 15 T; capsule ends R32; outer edge break 0.5-1.0; top hole 12; lower hole 12; hole center spacing 64; rectangular relief 36 x 18 with R3 corners only if sample confirms; top metal insert/boss OD 29
material: Black EPDM or NR/SBR automotive mount rubber, Shore A 60 +/-5; steel insert if original design uses one
tolerance: outer +/-1.0; hole position +/-0.5; thickness +/-0.5; edge break 0.5-1.0
fabrication_method: Mould or cut from sheet/blank; punch clean holes; form rectangular relief cleanly only if released; bond/fit steel insert where required
hold_points: Caliper-check hole center spacing, thickness, insert/boss OD, and relief construction before making final pair
notes: Measured old-rubber dimensions are sufficient for quote and first article; this is separate from the main body isolator pads.

nominal_dimensions_mm: 3D envelope 165 L x 38 W x 8 T; plain flat strip; plan corners R1.5; top/bottom edge break 0.5-1.0; no through-holes in rubber by default; local end trim only if install sample proves it
material: Black EPDM or NR/SBR sheet rubber, Shore A 60 +/-5
tolerance: length/width +/-1.0; thickness +/-0.5; edge break 0.5-1.0; faces parallel <=0.5
fabrication_method: Cut from solid sheet/strip stock; smooth edges; reuse or trace steel retainer separately if needed
hold_points: Dry-fit first article on actual landing and apply only proven local trim
notes: Installed-location photos and measured old strip release the plain rubber geometry; the slotted steel is a separate retainer, not automatic rubber geometry.

source_candidates: ToJo 48304-60010; Cruiser Corps long bump stop
nominal_dimensions_mm: Target free height 70; Toyota-style two-ear steel saddle/backing plate; tapered/radiused progressive rubber body; flat rectangular strike face; base footprint BL x BW from vehicle bracket; bolt/stud pitch P and hole/thread D from vehicle; contact face centred on axle strike pad within +/-5
material: NR/SBR automotive bump-stop rubber Shore A 70 +/-5 bonded/captive to new coated steel saddle
tolerance: height +/-1; base/holes +/-0.5 after vehicle release; contact centre +/-5; saddle must not bend; bond/captive joint must survive compression
fabrication_method: Mould/cast Toyota-style progressive tapered bump stop with new steel saddle/backing plate; no simple cut block
hold_points: Measure cleaned bracket, bolt pattern, loaded gap, full-bump clearance, and strike-pad offset before mould release; require sketch/CAD and material declaration
notes: Old decayed rubber is not the master. Use docs/bump-stop-fabrication-spec-20260504.md and bump_stop_vehicle_measurement_control.svg.

material: NR/SBR automotive bump-stop rubber Shore A 70 +/-5 bonded/captive to new coated steel saddle

fabrication_method: Mould/cast Toyota-style short right-front progressive bump stop with new steel saddle/backing plate; no simple cut block

source_candidates: ToJo 48304-60010; Cruiser Corps long bump stop
nominal_dimensions_mm: Target free height 70 each; rear pair matched within 1; Toyota-style two-ear steel saddles/backing plates; tapered/radiused progressive rubber bodies; flat rectangular strike faces; base footprint BL x BW from each rear bracket; bolt/stud pitch P and hole/thread D from vehicle; contact faces centred within +/-5
material: NR/SBR automotive bump-stop rubber Shore A 70 +/-5 bonded/captive to new coated steel saddles

fabrication_method: Mould/cast Toyota-style progressive matched rear pair with new steel saddles/backing plates; no simple cut blocks

notes: Make rear stops as a matched pair after final ride height and axle travel are checked.
